facts.fact: Union Budget 2026-27 was presented on 1 February 2026
facts.quote: Budget 2026-2027 Speech of Nirmala Sitharaman Minister of Finance February 1, 2026

facts.fact: The fiscal deficit in BE 2026-27 is estimated at 4.3% of GDP (Budget Speech para 94)
facts.quote: In line with the new fiscal prudence path of debt consolidation, the fiscal deficit in BE 2026-27 is estimated to be 4.3 percent of GDP.

facts.fact: In rupees the BE 2026-27 fiscal deficit is Rs 16,95,768 crore; RE 2025-26 Rs 15,58,492 crore (4.4%), BE 2025-26 Rs 15,68,936 crore (4.4%), Actuals 2024-25 Rs 15,74,431 crore (4.8%) (Budget at a Glance)
RE 2025-26 fiscal deficit is 4.4% of GDP, the same as BE 2025-26
facts.quote: estimated at par with BE of 2025-26 at 4.4 percent of GDP.

facts.fact: Debt-to-GDP is estimated at 55.6% in BE 2026-27 against 56.1% in RE 2025-26
facts.quote: the debt-to-GDP ratio is estimated to be 55.6 percent of GDP in BE 2026-27, compared to 56.1 percent of GDP in RE 2025-26.

facts.fact: The Government targets a debt-to-GDP ratio of 50±1% by 2030-31
facts.quote: I had indicated that the Central Government would target reaching a debt-to- GDP ratio of 50±1 percent by 2030-31.

facts.fact: Revenue deficit in BE 2026-27 is 1.5% of GDP
Primary deficit in BE 2026-27 is 0.7% of GDP
Net market borrowings from dated securities are estimated at Rs 11.7 lakh crore and gross market borrowings at Rs 17.2 lakh crore
facts.quote: To finance the fiscal deficit, the net market borrowings from dated securities are estimated at ₹11.7 lakh crore. The balance financing is expected to come from small savings and other sources. The gross market borrowings are estimated at ₹17.2 lakh crore.

summary: All fiscal figures confirmed on the Budget 2026-27 speech (paras 92-97) and Budget at a Glance: FD 4.3% / Rs 16,95,768 crore BE 2026-27.
